messages.subject: GSoC-R, number of students
parts:
I have had enquiries from four students about the ggenealogy project, all of them have successfully completed the test, which was perhaps too easy, and three students about the nlmeviz project, two of them have successfully completed that test, which was quite difficult.

Is there any chance of having more than one student per project?

messages.subject: Re: GSoC-R, number of students

My understanding is no. This gets asked in some form or other each year.
I suspect that the way round it is to segment the projects and label
them as separate ones.
